CBD 360 Degree was one day conference, conducted on 5th August.

It has provided an invaluable platform for medical professionals to learn and exchange insight directly from skilled surgeons, radiologist and gastroenterologist in real time about the issues focussed on the problems around common bile duct.

It was an invaluable learning and teaching initiative of ILS in association with AMASI chapter of Eastern India under leadership of Dr. Om Tantia.

The event’s success was further amplified by enthusiastic participation of 250 delegates including faculty members from Kolkata, Delhi, Chennai Bhubaneswar and Imphal.

ILS Academics and Research Foundation had organized a face to face single theme conference on 24th July 2022 at AltAir Boutique Hotel, Salt Lake, Kolkata under the aegis of IMA North-West Calcutta.

The theme of conference was “Emergencies in Medical Practice”. The conference was attended by around 300 delegates & reputed national faculties, who are expert in their respective field. The theme was relevant to every doctor in practice as topics will be of importance for each & every specialty.

To mark this occasion, we are also releasing a book titled, “Emergencies in Medical Practice”, edited by  Dr. Om Tantia, Dr. G. S. Goyal & Dr. Tamonas Chaudhuri. The unique book deals with first hand management of common emergencies.  Such kind of a book are uncommon in publication.

Contact WBSMF or visit their official website for a list of approved institutes and admission

Medical emergencies usually deal with life-threatening situations and carry dire consequences. In these critical moments it is important for the clinician dealing with them to be equipped with the knowledge and correct guidelines regarding their management. Thus, clinicians dealing with emergency patients need to be a jack of all specialties. For example, a well-respected surgeon may be at wits end when faced with a cardiac emergency while traveling on a flight. Similarly, an endocrinologist may not know the correct protocol to be followed when treating a trauma patient. Similarly, treatment of snakebite is clouding by lots of myths.
Aim behind this book is to provide a comprehensive overview of all the common emergencies faced in clinical practice with evidence-based current guidelines. Each chapter deals with a specific emergency, has been written and reviewed by leading experts in their respective fields. The material is concise with salient points for emergencies at the end and has been backed by a number of illustrations to keep the reader engaged.
ILS Academics and Research Foundation is proud to launch Emergencies in Medical Practice Book, edited by Dr. Om Tantia, Dr. G. S. Goyal & Dr. Tamonas Chaudhuri. This unique book deals with first hand management of common emergencies. Such kind of a book are uncommon in publication. The book has been released by Swami Satyeshanandaji, Ramkrishna Mission, Belur Moth.

We hope that the book will serve as a useful tool for all clinicians, especially those who deal with emergencies in their routine practice.

ILS Hospitals Salt Lake is recognized as FOGSI (Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India) / IAGE Gynae Endoscopic Training Center in Eastern India.  ILS Academia, Salt Lake is conducting basic and advanced courses in Gynae endoscopy at regular intervals. Attending students get 40 hours of hands-on training, didactic lectures, OT observer ship, and pre & post evaluation and suturing training. Every participant will receive a Fellowship Training Certificate from FOGSI / ILS Hospitals. Till 2022 ILS Academia Salt Lake has successfully conducted 8 batches of FOGSI/IAGE Gynae Endoscopic Training.
